aboutGame.title: What is Valor Mortis?
paragraphs: Valor Mortis is a first-person dark fantasy action RPG from One More Level, the studio behind Ghostrunner. Set in a plague-ravaged alternate 19th century, it puts you in the boots of a resurrected soldier who returns from death with supernatural powers the living were never meant to hold.

Combat is deliberate and punishing: you read enemy tells, choose between parry, dodge, and guard, then convert recovery frames into damage. Across the campaign you upgrade sabers, firearms, and armor, unlock new abilities, and fight through plague-touched hordes and towering bosses.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Valor Mortis, its combat, platforms, and release.

items.question: What is Valor Mortis?
items.answer: Valor Mortis is a first-person dark fantasy soulslike from One More Level, set in a plague-ravaged alternate 19th century. You play a resurrected soldier who returns with supernatural powers and fights through a world where death has claimed everything. The Valor Mortis Wiki collects beginner guides, combat breakdowns, weapon and enemy references, and release news in one place.

items.question: When does Valor Mortis release?
items.answer: Valor Mortis has not received an official release date yet. The Steam store page is live for wishlisting, and the game has been announced for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

items.question: Is Valor Mortis a soulslike?
items.answer: Yes. Valor Mortis builds on soulslike fundamentals: deliberate melee combat, parry timing, stamina management, punishing enemy tells, and checkpoint-based exploration, all from a first-person perspective.

items.question: What platforms is Valor Mortis on?
items.answer: Valor Mortis is announced for PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. Handheld and last-generation console versions have not been announced.

items.question: How do I start in Valor Mortis?
items.answer: Begin with the Valor Mortis beginner guide: finish the tutorial area, commit to one weapon, learn the heal input early, and practice parrying telegraphed attacks before your first boss.
